name: application-calendar
title: Calendar
description: Single-month date grid with previous/next navigation, a highlighted today, and a selectable date.
useWhen: Letting a user browse and pick a single date, such as scheduling an event or setting a due date.
Displaying a month-at-a-glance view with the current day highlighted for orientation.
Building a date picker's dropdown/popover content — pair with a trigger input.
avoidWhen: You need a full multi-month range picker with linked start/end selection — extend this pattern rather than using it as-is.
The date only needs typing, not browsing — a plain text or native date input is lighter weight.
You need a dense event calendar with multiple items per day — this is a date picker, not a scheduling grid.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width single-month grid that fits comfortably down to narrow mobile viewports; wrap in a popover or dialog when embedding inline would crowd the layout.
accessibility: Each day is a real <button> so it is reachable and activatable via keyboard, not a styled <div> or <span>.
The current day carries aria-current="date" and the selected day carries aria-pressed="true" so both states are announced by assistive tech.
Previous/next month controls have explicit aria-label text since they are icon-only buttons.
Disabled trailing/leading days (if hidden) should use the disabled attribute rather than styling alone.

variants.title: Calendar
variants.description: Single-month date grid with month navigation, today highlight, and a selected date.
accessibility: Day buttons are focusable and operable with keyboard alone; today and selected states are conveyed with aria attributes, not color alone.

variants.title: Calendar (Dark)
variants.description: Single-month date grid adapted for dark surfaces, with month navigation, today highlight, and a selected date.
accessibility: Today and selected colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
